title: Tests must use monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path) instead of CliRunner.isolated_filesystem
answers: CliRunner isolated_filesystem is deprecated in click, what to use instead in tests
how do I run a click CLI test inside a temp directory
isolated filesystem DeprecationWarning error in pytest
change working directory for CliRunner invoke tests
body:
Symptom: The test suite fails with a DeprecationWarning saying 'isolated_filesystem' is deprecated once tests call CliRunner.isolated_filesystem (deprecated in Click 8.5, removal planned for Click 9.0).
Root cause: Tests in tests/test_cli.py and tests/claude_code/test_cli.py wrapped runner.invoke in runner.isolated_filesystem() to get a temp working directory.
Fix pattern: Add monkeypatch and tmp_path to the test signature, call monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path) first, then call runner.invoke directly with no with-block. Keep the existing runner fixture or CliRunner() instance.
Constraints: Use this for any test that needs a clean cwd around CliRunner. Do not reintroduce isolated_filesystem, since the pytest filter turns its warning into an error. Keep mock.patch context managers in their own with-block when they were previously grouped with isolated_filesystem.
applies: Pytest tests in this repository that use click's CliRunner and need a temporary working directory.
says: Command line interface test suite fails with deprecation warnings on modern library versions.
Update command line automated tests to avoid deprecated filesystem isolation.
Command line tool tests crash due to isolated filesystem deprecation errors.
search: Tests using click's CliRunner must switch from the deprecated isolated_filesystem to monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path). This prevents pytest from failing on Click 8.5 deprecation warnings in test suites like tests/test_cli.py and tests/claude_code/test_cli.py. Call monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path) before runner.invoke directly without a with-block, while keeping any mock.patch context managers in their own blocks.
